sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Sector breadth remains narrow with only Energy and Healthcare holding all-green profiles, while Communication Services deteriorates to the bottom rank.

Energy commands market leadership, sustaining a top-3 rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows alongside a market-leading 0.917 momentum score. Healthcare provides secondary defensive strength as the only other all-green sector, backed by an 0.800 momentum score. Meanwhile, Technology holds firm near the top with 0.783 momentum and a rank_ytd of 2.

Rotation remains muted across the broader market, but deterioration is sharpest in Communication Services, which shed 2 spots over the last five sessions to hit rank 11 with anemic 0.100 momentum. Marginal short-term rank improvements from Consumer Cyclical and Utilities reflect minor positioning rather than broad strength, as both remain pinned in the bottom tiers of momentum.

## Strength
- **Narrow All-Green Breadth:** Only 2 of 11 sectors (Energy and Healthcare) are positive across all measured timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, and YTD).
- **Energy Dominance:** Holds the #1 spot across rank metrics with a 0.917 momentum score and stands as the sole sector demonstrating sustained top-3 rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Top Momentum Cluster:** Energy (0.917), Healthcare (0.800), and Technology (0.783, rank_ytd 2) represent the clear upper tier of relative strength, followed by Consumer Defensive at 0.650.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Communication Services Collapsing:** Down 2 spots over the last 5 sessions to rank 11, posting the lowest momentum score across all sectors at 0.100.
- **Low-Tier Bounces:** Consumer Cyclical (+1 spot to rank 10, momentum 0.417) and Utilities (+1 spot to rank 9, momentum 0.333) showed the only rank gains over the past 5 sessions.
- **Entrenched Laggards:** Real Estate (0.300 momentum, rank 8) and Industrials (0.317 momentum, rank 6) remain mired in the bottom tier alongside Utilities and Communication Services.

## Divergences
- **Communication Services Breakdown:** The sector's drop to rank 11 with a 0.100 momentum score reflects a sharp disconnect from top-tier growth peer Technology (rank 2, momentum 0.783).
- **Counter-Trend Repositioning:** Rank gains over the past five sessions were limited entirely to lower-momentum groups (Consumer Cyclical at 0.417 and Utilities at 0.333), while mid- and upper-tier sectors remained flat in 5-day rank changes.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and select healthcare niches lead broad market strength, while industrial and basic materials groups suffer sharp short-term rank deteriorations.

Leadership remains concentrated in traditional defensives and energy, with 23 of 144 industry groups maintaining all-green breadth across all timeframes. Diagnostics & Research (0.880) and Oil & Gas E&P (0.874) pace overall momentum, while sustained rank strength persists across Oil & Gas Integrated and Health Information Services. 

Meanwhile, rotation is evident as capital moves toward select services and specialty real estate, with Rental & Leasing Services climbing 22 spots into the top 30. Conversely, sudden weakness has hit cyclicals and resources: Metal Fabrication tumbled 30 spots, while Silver and Biotechnology each dropped 18 spots over the past five sessions.

## Strength
- **Broad Breadth:** 23 of 144 groups hold all-green status across week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD windows.
- **Top Momentum Groups:** Diagnostics & Research leads all industries with a 0.880 momentum score (rank 24 YTD), closely followed by Oil & Gas E&P at 0.874 (rank 10 YTD) and REIT - Hotel & Motel at 0.868 (rank 9 YTD).
- **Sustained Leaders:** Oil & Gas Integrated (momentum 0.865) and Health Information Services (momentum 0.84) continue to anchor the top 36 across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons alongside groups like Medical Distribution and Software - Application.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Top 5-Day Rank Gainers:** Rental & Leasing Services surged 22 spots to rank 30 (momentum 0.81), Security & Protection Services advanced 16 spots to rank 55 (momentum 0.71), and REIT - Specialty gained 14 spots to rank 50 (momentum 0.57).
- **Sharpest Deteriorations:** Metal Fabrication fell 30 spots to rank 83 (momentum 0.21), Utilities - Regulated Water shed 19 spots to rank 70 (momentum 0.40), and both Biotechnology (rank 61) and Silver (rank 64) dropped 18 spots.
- **Deepest Momentum Laggards:** Advertising Agencies anchors the bottom at 0.035 (rank 144 YTD), followed by Resorts & Casinos (0.093, rank 138 YTD) and Solar (0.099, rank 139 YTD).

## Divergences
- **Fading Momentum:** Biotechnology is weakening rapidly, dropping 18 spots over 5 days despite a 0.60 momentum score; Medical Distribution (momentum 0.67) and Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.62) also show cracks, falling 9 and 8 spots, respectively.
- **Emerging Turnarounds:** REIT - Retail jumped 9 spots over 5 sessions despite lagging momentum of 0.48, while Real Estate - Development and Engineering & Construction each improved 7 spots despite weak 0.33 momentum scores.
